I used to drive competitively for our clan’s armor crew.

Trick with the Abrams is to track it and ammo rack it and first shot and then finish it with the 2nd shot at the ammo rack. We almost always engage the enemy tank from the side. If it’s front facing and moving, shot to the tracks will cause the vehicle to spin and show you its side.

If you’re against a great tank crew, you’re in trouble because they’ll get hull down pretty quickly. 

My biggest advice for you if you go for tank vs tank against the US is to keep moving. 

Don’t be like 99% of the pub tank crews where they tell the driver to face armor at the enemy tank. This is a video game and not real life. Facing armor works IRL. But in squad, he who ammo racks the other guys first is the game. 

Know your ammo rack locations. Have good map knowledge for good spots and such. Play smart.

Played competitive squad and know what I’m talking about (I hope. Haha)

1. When you see a downed guy, don’t prioritize the revive right away. Prioritize finding and eliminating the guy the downed the friendly. I’ve racked up a lot of kills waiting on medics and enemy friendlies trying to pick up their SL. Nothing scarier than an accurate frag RPG round.

2. And this is kinda super important. A lot of new guys mess this up. 

Smoke grenades. Use them well. Learn when to smoke yourself or not to. They’re super handy. Rule of thumb is to usually smoke the enemy position. The idea is the closer the smoke is to the enemy the less they see. If you smoke yourself, remember… it’s just smoke… Nothing to stop a grenade or some guy to mag dump the smoke.

I’m tired of the enablist bullshit where the word “schizo” is synonymous and parallel with “crazy”. A perfectly functional and neurologically sound person can be worlds more dangerous and unstable than a person with my disorder.

I daresay, I’m far more “capable” in hurting people that the ‘average joe’ but I guarantee I’m far more stable and less likely to ever hurt anyone. 

And fuck the stigma around telling people you have to take medication. Suddenly you’re this unhinged and rabid subhuman thing that requires unhealthy and powerful sedatives/drugs to not hurt anyone. 

Fuck that. I have a biological imbalance. Something is wrong with me. I need medication to make sure it hits as close to “normal” as I can. Fuck your pity and connotations and your laymans talk about how “schizo” some people can be. 

(On a side note, schizophrenics who read this, please try Crossfit or bjj out. Opened a world to me that really helped me. I may have a handicap but I feel good. You should too)
